run_test_experiment: run a test experiment using TinyDbObserver to record start, heartbeat, artifact, resource, and completion events
fetch_metadata_by_indices: fetch experiment metadata from TinyDbReader by numeric index or list of indices
fetch_metadata_by_query: fetch experiment metadata from TinyDbReader using a TinyDB Query object with regex or field filters
fetch_files_by_index: fetch experiment artifacts, resources, and source files as BufferedReader objects by index
fetch_report_by_index: fetch a formatted text report of an experiment including parameters, result, dependencies, and outputs
